bills.title: Public safety funding
bills.description: Improving public safety funding by providing resources to local governments and state and local criminal justice agencies, and authorizing a local option tax.

bills.title: Payment card processing/tax
bills.description: Creating a business and occupation tax deduction and increasing the rate for persons conducting payment card processing activities.

bills.title: Employee ownership program
bills.description: Eliminating the Washington employee ownership program.

bills.title: K-12 education funding
bills.description: Investing in the state's paramount duty to fund K-12 education and build strong and safe communities.

bills.title: Business and occupation tax
bills.description: Modifying business and occupation tax surcharges, rates, and the advanced computing surcharge cap, clarifying the business and occupation tax deduction for certain investments, and creating a temporary business and occupation tax surcharge on large companies.

bills.title: Taxes on loan interest
bills.description: Supporting wildfire mitigation by modifying RCW 82.04.29005, concerning taxes on loan interest.

bills.title: Coal-fired electric plant
bills.description: Eliminating preferential treatment related to a coal-fired electric generating plant.

bills.title: Local government fund use
bills.description: Providing local governments tax resources and fund flexibility.

bills.title: Insurer taxes
bills.description: Concerning taxes imposed on insurers operating within the state.

bills.title: Tax preferences
bills.description: Adopting recommendations from the tax preference performance review process, eliminating obsolete tax preferences, clarifying legislative intent, and addressing changes in constitutional law.

bills.title: Tax rates/cap. gains, estate
bills.description: Increasing funding to the education legacy trust account by creating a more progressive rate structure for the capital gains tax and estate tax.

bills.title: Excise taxes
bills.description: Modifying the application and administration of certain excise taxes.

bills.title: Prescription drugs/taxes
bills.description: Removing a tax exemption for the warehousing and reselling of prescription drugs.

bills.title: Data center equipment/taxes
bills.description: Expiring tax exemptions for data centers. (REVISED FOR ENGROSSED: Removing a tax exemption for the replacement of equipment for data centers.)
